ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Kubernetes Network Policy Change
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when a Azure Kubernetes network policy is modified or deleted. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/NETWORKING\.K8S\.IO\/NETWORKPOLICIES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/NETWORKING\.K8S\.IO\/NETWORKPOLICIES\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/EXTENSIONS\/NETWORKPOLICIES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/EXTENSIONS\/NETWORKPOLICIES\/DELETE")
